trend.summary: On Oct 23, 2026 ByteDance's Volcano Engine released Seedance 2.5 4K, a video model aimed at film and TV production, in trials with selected enterprise customers; a draft mode lets users test shots with cheaper 480p previews before generating the final 4K version. Video models keep getting better at making shots; turning shots into a finished short ad (captions, cuts, formats) is still a separate edit.

sources.title: ByteDance launches Seedance 2.5 4K video model for film production (TechNode)

angle: Video models make the shots; funkbox does the edit around them. Drop in clips, stills or screen recordings, cut on the beat, keep captions exactly as approved, and get 9:16 and 16:9 from one edit. No product is named in the public text.
